findings.title: Final local unmet-criteria summary remains a partial summary
findings.finding: A fresh-control cascading-alert change at185 produces an unsupported acceptance at186, release_boundary_obeyed=false and deployment_demand_fulfilled=false, yet final_observations.unmet_criteria contains no scope/uncovered-feature entry and its listed Booleans are all false. The accepted item itself retains out_of_scope_features, so the failure is reconstructable. This does not mask the top-level outcome and does not invalidate the eight retained episodes, but the local summary must not be used as an exhaustive all-obligations success indicator.

findings.title: Terminal current-record-path label does not imply successful current-data performance
findings.finding: When a stale display emerges at185 after the sole inspection, the actor accepts stale data186 without a subsequent stop; the observer correctly returns stale_items_accepted=1, protocol_violations=1 and demand=false. The terminal phase nevertheless remains completed_current_record_path because it distinguishes only withheld, stopped and other paths. Likewise an unchecked current acceptance has that phase. Treat terminal_state as a path label, not a success or freshness verdict.

findings.title: The executed contrast is conditional on authored behavior and hindsight
findings.finding: Easy and medium use different authored inspection schedules around the same acceptance time:184 before186 versus192 after186. The medium_cue_first sensitivity probe makes that dependency explicit. The simulator branches on states and event timing rather than difficulty labels; no preset outcome lookup was found. This is still a retrospective, uncalibrated deterministic model, not an empirical intervention effect, measured novice behavior, uncertainty distribution or preregistered test. senior_available is retained metadata rather than an active behavioral mechanism.

findings.title: The hard-after-start episode demonstrates channel loss after an earlier stop
findings.finding: The operator stops for the initial sensor contradiction at184. Compound flags arrive190; radio loss drops the handoff780, and restoration1085 produces no invented retry. This is a communication-loss-after-stop probe, not evidence of detection or diagnosis of emerging compound faults by an actively accepting operator. The primary hard episode establishes refusal of known unsupported scope. Its containment=true during no-start is non-acceptance, not demonstrated ability to perform the hard demand.

findings.title: Functional dependencies do not identify professional competency or team effects
findings.finding: The traces illustrate dependencies on a checked reference, timing of cue use, realized logs and available communication. Labeling these as systems engineering, assessment or coordination is an authored analytic mapping. There is no independent competency assessment, matched individual design, randomized team allocation or team-size comparison. An appropriately authorized individual could possess several functions; the data do not establish that a team is necessary or superior. The retained competency-dependencies artifact appropriately disclaims a team effect.

gate_decision.scope: The v3 snapshots reproducibly execute the unchanged frozen intervention adapter against the same eight authored scenarios. No remaining material false success or source-fidelity blocker was found in those retained inputs or the independently rerun v1/v2 blocking counterexamples. The earlier handoff, scope, sensor transition, unchecked acceptance, aid/logging realization and recording-boundary defects are corrected for the checks actually performed.
gate_decision.general_correctness: This is not a proof for every possible accepted model, event combination or state mutation, nor a certification of physical simulator fidelity. Use the full outcomes and trace rather than partial local summaries or terminal labels.
gate_decision.empirical_scope: No human learning, professional competency, diagnosis, delayed transfer, utility-readiness or team-versus-individual conclusion is authorized.
gate_decision.no_repair: Only this audit file was written to the repository, using exclusive creation; all temporary executions used /tmp.

warranted_conclusions: The retained v3 results arise from deterministic executed state transitions and exactly replay from their retained source/model snapshots.

Within the authored scenario inputs, early inspection prevents the modeled stale acceptance; late inspection does not erase it; actual numeric handoff content and modeled channel/recipient availability determine acknowledgement.
The tested initial and prestart scope failures prevent practice; missing mandatory intermediate logs prevent demand fulfillment even when later logging succeeds.
The model illustrates conditional functional dependencies and the limits of a frozen intervention under unavailable references, recipients, communication channels or coverage.
unwarranted_conclusions: That all possible model inputs or environment histories are correct because24 tests and eight retained runs pass.
That terminal completed_current_record_path or an all-false local unmet-criteria subset proves overall success.
That difficulty contrasts identify effects of training, novice expertise, team design or any particular professional competency.
That the hard-after-start probe demonstrates active emerging-compound-fault detection or that a correctly withheld hard case demonstrates hard-demand capability.
That the intervention establishes independent diagnosis, delayed retention, transfer, live utility readiness or safety certification.
limitations: The model is explicitly retrospective and uncalibrated. All timings, values, response profiles, aid-identification abilities and availability conditions are authored assumptions.

World initialization, scripted actor behavior and observer logic are functionally separate but share one trusted process. Actor inspection compares visible display/reference fields; reference checks intentionally use authored scripted truth. There is no independently blinded actor or measurement process.

The final participant log includes accepted-item fields populated by the simulation observer, including stale and scope flags. These are modeled record contents, not independent observations made by a human participant.
One scheduled inspection and one acceptance attempt do not imply continuous monitoring, additional diagnosis, retries, recovery, fallback communication or extra staffing.
Receipt and trace hashes establish byte consistency and replay, not independently attested authorship chronology, preregistration or authenticity against an author controlling all files.
Checks of structured aid content and synthetic identification do not establish a human can locate or apply the aid, and virtual time does not establish actual preparation capacity.

The five authorized original files support exact-byte endorsements and source commitments. This bounded audit did not expand into other original dialogue or separately validate every historical consultation assertion.
Independent diagnosis and delayed transfer are unassessed rather than failed; human_learning_outcome correctly remains null.
